entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE initial registration to the 5G network.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer that prevents initial registration when running, except for specific high priority or emergency cases.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer that prevents initial registration with follow-on request pending when running, except for high priority or emergency cases.

entities.name: Timer T3510
entities.description: Timer stopped during abnormal case handling in initial registration.

entities.name: Timer T3511
entities.description: Timer started when registration attempt counter < 5; when expired, registration procedure restarts if needed.

entities.name: Timer T3502
entities.description: Timer started when registration attempt counter = 5; UE enters deregistered state and may perform PLMN selection.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION
entities.description: UE state entered when registration attempt counter < 5 and timer T3511 is started.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
entities.description: Optional UE state entered when registration attempt counter = 5; UE performs PLMN selection.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: UE state where initial registration is in progress; collision with de-registration may occur.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message from network that may trigger re-registration or cause procedure collision.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: Message from network accepting registration.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT
entities.description: Message from network rejecting registration with specific 5GMM cause values.

entities.name: REGISTRATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GS registration type
entities.description: IE indicating type of registration, e.g., initial registration or emergency registration.

entities.name: Access barred
entities.description: Condition where lower layers indicate access attempt is barred for certain access categories.

entities.name: TAI changed
entities.description: Condition where current Tracking Area Identity changes before registration completion.

entities.name: Registration attempt counter
entities.description: Counter tracking number of registration attempts; incremented on failure up to 5.

entities.name: UE initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed when UE initiated de-registration is required during initial registration.

entities.name: Registration procedure for mobility registration update
entities.description: Procedure initiated when initial registration is aborted due to TAI change and current TAI not in TAI list.

relations.description: Initial registration shall not start if timer T3346 is running, except for high priority or emergency cases.
Initial registration with follow-on request pending shall not start if timer T3447 is running, except for high priority or emergency cases.
Initial registration shall not start if lower layers indicate access is barred.
Initial registration shall be aborted and re-initiated if TAI changes before completion.
Initial registration procedure is performed in state 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED.
Initial registration procedure includes sending REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Initial registration procedure may include sending REGISTRATION COMPLETE message.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS registration type IE.
Receipt of DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with re-registration required indication triggers initial registration.
Initial registration failure increments registration attempt counter unless already 5.
If registration attempt counter < 5, timer T3511 is started.
If registration attempt counter = 5, timer T3502 is started.
If registration attempt counter < 5, state changes to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION.
If registration attempt counter = 5, state may change to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH for PLMN selection.
When timer T3511 expires, initial registration procedure is restarted if still required.
If TAI changes and current TAI not in TAI list, mobility registration update procedure is initiated.
If UE initiated de-registration required, initial registration is aborted and de-registration procedure performed.
If DEREGISTRATION REQUEST received in state 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED, de-registration is aborted and initial registration progresses.
